parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no structural evidence whatsoever: differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, and shared_field_count are all null, and the members array is empty. Without any field lists, method signatures, or overlap metrics to ground a recommendation, there is no defensible basis for proposing a refactor between StitchableWallpaperView (Renderers/) and MaterialControls (DebugUI/ThemeDebugOverlay/). The two types occupy distinct subdirectories within the Wallpaper package — one is a renderer, the other a debug-UI control — suggesting any structural coincidence is domain-incidental rather than a genuine duplication opportunity.
